cards.claim: Mahmud I was the son of Mustafa II.
cards.quote: He was born at Edirne Palace, the son of Mustafa II (1664–1703); his mother was Saliha Sabkati Valide Sultan.

cards.claim: Nasir al-Din Mahmud I's father was Malik Shah I.
cards.quote: 1088 Died October 1094 ( 1094-10-00 ) ( aged 5–6 ) Names Nasir al-Din Mahmud I Father Malik Shah I Mother Terken Khatun Religion Sunni Islam Life edit In 1092 , when Malik Shah I was assassinated shortly after Nizam al-Mulk , Taj al-Mulk nominated Mahmud as Sultan and set out for Isfahan .

raw_card.claim: Turkan Khatun, the last wife of Malik Shah, tried to win the throne for her 4 years old son Mahmud.
